+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in stderr with their decoded error text."""
+    header = b"CLIXML\r\n"
+    closing_tag = b"</Objs>"
+    result = bytearray()
+    cursor = 0
+
+    while True:
+        header_idx = stderr.find(header, cursor)
+        if header_idx == -1:
+            result.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+            break
+
+        marker_start = header_idx
+        for marker in (b"#< ", b"<# "):
+            if stderr[max(0, header_idx - len(marker)):header_idx] == marker:
+                marker_start = header_idx - len(marker)
+                break
+        block_start = header_idx + len(header)
+        end_idx = stderr.find(closing_tag, block_start)
+        if end_idx == -1:
+            result.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+            break
+
+        block_end = end_idx + len(closing_tag)
+        # Include the CLIXML marker in parsing while retaining any preceding text.
+        block = stderr[marker_start:block_end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                decoded_block = block.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                decoded_block = block.decode("cp437").encode("utf-8")
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(decoded_block)
+        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+            result.extend(stderr[cursor:block_end])
+        else:
+            result.extend(stderr[cursor:marker_start])
+            result.extend(decoded)
+        cursor = block_end
+
+    return bytes(result)
+
